title: Add `template_examples_resource_files()`
description:
Adds a simple function to read the `examples.yml` file used for the Examples article and produce a `resource_files` YAML snippet to be used in the frontmatter of the `examples.Rmd` article.

Without the additional field, images that are relative to the examples article won't be moved into the pkgdown site.

From an example in learnr:

```
├── examples.Rmd
├── examples.yml
└── images
    └── tutorial-ex-setup-r.png
```

```
# examples.yml
- title: "Setting Up R"
  img: images/tutorial-ex-setup-r.png
  href: https://learnr-examples.shinyapps.io/ex-setup-r/
  source: https://github.com/rstudio/learnr/tree/master/inst/tutorials/ex-setup-r/ex-setup-r.Rmd
  showcase: true
```

```r
template_examples_resource_files("examples.yml")
#> resource_files:
#>  - images/tutorial-ex-setup-r.png
```

title: Add a helper to set Github labels
description:
This put whet I have in Gist into **quillt**

https://gist.github.com/cderv/04b90cd13e833b97bf67ca643ecbd054

Basically, it is a helper to manage github labels easily in our repo. Only difference with `usethis::use_tidy_label()` is that the default `question` labels is not rename to `reprex` as it tidyverse repo. 

It happens we have a often some questions asked in issues and I find it useful to labels those with the question tags. We don't do yet analysis on the issue label but we could. 
`reprex` is really associated when an issue not has a correct reprex and one is expected. 

This function was applied in blogdown a while back now: 
https://github.com/rstudio/blogdown/labels

Any idea for other modification ?

title: Add a function to easily add issue templates in package quillt-related
description:
During meeting we talked about simplifying the issue templates in repo. As a reminder, https://github.com/rstudio/blogdown/issues/new/choose

We mention: 

* Do not set tag as untagged issue means that it requires triage
* Reduce options in chooser - no need for documentation for example

I decided it could be a good idea to have them stored here to easily set them and keep a common set of template. 

Suggested changes : 

* 2 templates: Bug and Feature request. They differentiate by the help instruction inside. I think the text should be a comment because
   * It opens Github when you click in source mode anyway, so formatting is not seen
   * This prevent having unrelated text still there in the issue when posted because the user did not remove.
  I also make the text less imperative and more like advice to follow. 
* Keep the links to other site: Issue guide, SO and community - but make that optional in quilt function
* By default does not allow empty issue with no template

This require more documentation for future us, but I open a PR to get your first feedback @apreshill ! 
Thanks!

title: Adds option to relocate #functions before #usage
description:
I have a number of reference topic pages that document a family of functions within the same reference page, since they share arguments and functionality. I frequently find that, in these cases, it can be intimidating or confusing to open with the **usage** section. Instead the **Functions** section, which is a list of functions with their description (from the `#' @describeIn <parent> <Function description>` roxygen tag), generally provides a more gentle and orienting introduction to the functions in the reference page.

Rather than try to address this at the pkgdown level, this PR "fixes it in post-production" by adding a small amount of JS to rewrite the reference page if the **Functions** section is present. This is turned off by default, but can be opted in via a `template$params$relocationFunctions` option in `_pkgdown.yml`. The one non-opt-in change is that I've added a **Usage** heading above what was previously just `<pre class="usage">`.

Note: I'm open to renaming the param or anything else in here.

* Adds `content-reference-topic.html` template from pkgdown BS3 template
* Updates template to add Usage heading above usage section
* Adds JavaScript to relocate #functions before #usage and update the TOC

This is opt-in and has to be enabled with

```yaml
template:
  params:
    relocateFunctions: true
```

Here's a quick example (which may not be the best because it's rather obvious... but you can see that the **Functions** section comes very late in the page otherwise).

<details><summary>Before</summary>

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5420529/109882911-97ba7180-7c48-11eb-9f21-1c66eeb775ca.png)

</details>

<details><summary>After</summary>

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5420529/109882952-a99c1480-7c48-11eb-8018-219cd911f51a.png)

</details>

title: Add some helpers to setup a project using quillt
description:
This PR tests the idea of adding some usethis-like helpers to setup a project to use **quillt** the way we defined it for Rmarkdown related project. 

* Help setup pkgdown using the quillt template, using common pkgdown configuration across project
* Help create required files to have a common base
* Help setting the action for pkgdown deployment

The idea is to have a place to store how to and offer helper to make it easy without copy pasting between projects. 

This is currently a first draft using mainly usethis function, some of which are not exported but are useful to not spend time rewriting them. 
If **quillt** is to be used only by us for the scope of Rmarkdown related package, I think it would be fine to have this. And it is also a good place to store all common steps and assets that should be used accross packages. 


To be discussed. Still WIP.
